title: Rickoshea
tagline: Scaling and simplifying  Dollar-cost Averaging using Superfluid
description: The world dollar-cost averaging into ETH costs a lot in fees and block space. Rickoshea le s you stream USDCx and get back ETHx which lets you DCA into ETH. Rickoshea can be used by savers to dollar cost average into ETH without making a lot of transactions on-chain. Rickoshea scales so that it can send ETHx to every saver in a single transaction.
how_its_made: Rickoshea using Superfluid's super apps and tokens to make the streaming work. The Rickoshea DApp lets you start streaming right away. We wrapped aAAVE in order to support DCA into aAAVE using Rickoshea. Our wrapped super aAAVE token didn't work on Kovan so we decided to just stick to ETH.
